evidence: Walked the brief and all three /instructions notes line by line against solution/app. Every asked-for capability has an implementation: sign-in gate with no data before auth (index.html #signin/#app hidden, server.js requireUser on every /api route and /transcripts/:id L500-501); role/client scoping and walls on list, thread, search, quotes, unread, mentions, link previews and transcripts (server.js canSee L189-201, previewsFor L226-235, mentionsFor L320-324, search L382-391, transcript L503-504); partner wall add/lift UI (index.html #wall-form, app.js renderWalls/setWall) with live removal via 2 s polling -> showUnavailable (app.js L640-651, L198-211); timers off/1/7/30 partner-only with immediate sweep and label beside title (server.js L466-476, L139-147; app.js applyMatter L216); hold place/release partner-only, hold blocks delete, release re-sweeps (server.js L451, L456-464); nested replies any depth in send order with quotes and deleted-parent placeholder, cross-matter reply refused (server.js threadFor L253-291, L405-409); edit with 'edited', staff versions, optimistic-version 409 keeping typed text (server.js L426-443, app.js L479-487); delete confirm/'Keep it' (app.js L338-345); safe formatting *bold*/`code`/'> ' quote/http(s) links target=_blank on escaped text, plain text in quotes, snippets, versions (textContent) and transcript (esc) (app.js L23-55); copyable message links with walled/deleted 'not available' previews and highlighted focus from link/search/mention (app.js copyLink, openMessageLink, applyMatter L240-243); @-mentions case-insensitive first name, suggestions from /api/matters/:id/people limited to viewers, recomputed on edit/delete (server.js L209-222, L339-345); per-user unread with 'New messages' line, mark-read on open, 'Mark unread' from any message, deleted excluded (server.js L243-245, L346-360; app.js L176-196, L516-524); Enter/Shift+Enter/Escape (app.js L411-422); idempotent client_key sends and seq ordering (server.js L403-417); polling preserves composer, scroll and open versions (app.js L226-239); transcript page with number, title, generated time, thread order, author, time, edited, On hold, held-edited versions, placeholders, no controls (server.js L496-517); refusals shown in place and persisted (state.messageErrors, composer/timer/wall errors); runtime contract (DB_PATH, 0.0.0.0:3000, health 200 before DB, seed-once, files relative to __dirname); phone layout media query (styles.css L117-127). Measured: scripted Playwright golden run on these exact source hashes (raw-evidence-index; re-verified sha256 of server.js f5d5801a..., app.js fd8df974..., seed b256f85e...) reports all 16 functional checks + gate_constraints true before restart and persistence + 6 polish checks true after a real kill/restart (functional-before.json/after.json). This is scripted evidence, not a configured judge run; hosted Oracle 0.9917 was on prior v2 bytes only. Weak-app probe: an app that only filtered walls in the matter list (not search/previews/mentions/transcript) or lacked mention suggestions would be graded down by brief text; the golden is not such an app. Conforming alternative probe: nothing in the golden imposes extra product requirements for this row. Minor observation (not a coverage gap): polling refreshes only the matter list and the open matter, so if a newly walled user is sitting on an already-rendered search-results or Mentions view, those rows (from the matter they had already seen) stay on screen until they navigate; clicking one returns 'Not available'. The brief's live-wall promise is stated for 'someone who already has the matter open', which the golden handles. Transcript renders *bold*/links as literal text, which the brief does not forbid.
run_verdict: CONFIRMED (scripted golden on current bytes; not a configured judge run)
